program: v20 follow-up - registered measurement: fixed-construction sequence families (reservoir, fixed-attention + ridge readout) on the matched-footprint frontier (13 Aug 2026)

registration_notes.N93.1: Engineering MEASUREMENT milestone, not a claim audit and NOT a novelty claim. It extends the sealed M133 frontier with two fixed-construction (no-backprop) sequence families.
registration_notes.N93.2: Question registered before measurement: at matched footprint on the deterministic DSL, how much of the trained transformer's advantage over the additive count model is recoverable by a FIXED-CONSTRUCTION sequence model - a reservoir (random fixed recurrence + ridge readout) and a fixed-attention extractor (random fixed QKV/FFN + ridge readout)? The gap between these families and the trained transformer IS the measured 'price of learning' for sequence models.
registration_notes.N93.3: Count-model and transformer points are REUSED from sealed M131/M133 evidence (never recomputed). Reservoir and fixed-attention points are newly computed with fixed seeds.
registration_notes.N93.4: Both new families keep the programme's identity: fixed nonlinear construction + CLOSED-FORM ridge readout (streaming Gram accumulation, same RidgeAccumulator arithmetic). No backprop anywhere.
registration_notes.N93.5: Reservoir: seeded random W_rec (spectral radius 0.9) + W_in (random, scaled), tanh state, ridge readout on the state trajectory (warmup 128 steps discarded). Fixed-attention: seeded random embeddings/QKV/output/FFN projections, softmax attention over a context window of 8, ridge readout on the mixed features. Both trained on the same train split, evaluated on the same test set.
registration_notes.N93.6: No pre-registered winner gate. A fixed-construction family getting close to (or beating) the trained transformer at matched footprint is reported as a measured fact with the gap; a large gap is also reported. The outcome in the small regime is genuinely unknown before measurement.
registration_notes.N93.7: Footprint = stored fp32 parameters (fixed matrices + ridge weights). Reported alongside fp16.
registration_notes.N93.8: Smoke runs use _smoke_note + _smoke_skip_gates and MUST refuse the sealed output dir.
registration_notes.N93.9: Dated snapshot; exact seeds, spectral radius, context window, ladder, and device recorded for byte-repeat.
